study: US500 CFD clock strategy full research pipeline
instrument: Exness US500 CFD; not ES futures

grid.disclosure: Our predeclared 8500-rule search; the video's exact search grid was not supplied. Prior 26 clock diagnostics are contained in this grid. This does not correct for undisclosed searches outside the study.

one_factor_baseline: Change original entry time, hold, weekday and side separately before full grid diagnostics; no indicators, stops or price targets added.
execution: Long: bid open plus causal historical spread at entry, bid open at exit. Short: bid entry, ask exit using causal exit spread. Require every minute from entry through exit. No interpolation, future spread fill, or candle close used as execution price.
neighbor_definition: Same weekday/side; entries +/-5 and +/-10 minutes and adjacent two holding lengths; one factor at a time, excluding candidate itself.

selection.development_score: 25th percentile neighbor daily cash Sharpe; tie break own daily cash Sharpe, then shorter hold, then configuration ID
selection.development_preferred_gates: 100 trades, >=99% eligible-window coverage, net PF>=1.15, +0.60-point assumed stress PF>1, >=2 profitable chronological thirds, >=60% profitable local neighbors
selection.validation_score: Minimum of development neighbor-P25 Sharpe and validation own daily cash Sharpe; tie break development score, shorter hold, ID
selection.validation_preferred_gates: 30 trades, >=99% coverage, PF>1, +0.60-point stress PF>1, >=50% profitable local neighbors
selection.fallback: If no shortlisted candidate clears both stages, select the best balanced score for exploratory diagnosis only, never call it validated.
selection.oos_top100: Evaluate locked development shortlist only after final freeze, diagnostic false-discovery check; never replace final candidate.

validation_tests.joint_fake_market: 5000 shared calendar-week sign-flip worlds across the entire 8500-rule development search. Gross moves flip; spreads always remain costs. Same week sign across all times and holds preserves cross-rule dependence and within-week volatility structure. Two-sided search is retained in every fake world. Max-Sharpe family p-value with plus-one correction; also fixed-rule p-value.
validation_tests.pbo: CSCV over 10 chronological development blocks, all 252 five-block train/test partitions; full 8500 rules, Sharpe rank out of sample, daily aggregation prevents overlapping intraday trades crossing folds.
validation_tests.deflated_sharpe: Saved pipeline approximation plus additional DSR using dispersion of daily SR across all 8500 development trials. Report conservative nominal independent-trial N=8500 assumption; correlated rules mean heuristic DSR, empirical joint-null is complementary.
validation_tests.monte_carlo: 10000 circular five-calendar-week block bootstrap paths, fixed-lot cash replay, same sampled daily sequence for PF, return and DD. Weekly blocks preserve weekday frequency. Also block lengths 1 and 10 weeks, 10000 each. Closed-PnL rule probabilities only; never substitute for floating-equity risk.
validation_tests.cost_stress: Recorded broker spread included. Extra 0.60 and 1.10 index points per roundtrip are assumed sensitivity scenarios, not measured slippage/commission. Measured slippage required before promotion.
validation_tests.native: Original and frozen candidate replay in an isolated MT5 tester, never live. Capture trade ledger, tick equity DD, timing and history quality. Disclose simulated vs real ticks and any incomplete native evidence.
validation_tests.leakage: Prefix invariance, future candle mutation, exact DST conversion, full missing-window rejection, short ask-exit cost, final manifest written before loading OOS, source hashes and split guards.
validation_tests.recent_windows: 1y,6m,3m and calendar years are diagnostic only after freeze.

provenance: 2020-2023 raw original results were already inspected. Parameter holdout is retrospective, not claimed genuinely untouched market history. Video rule is itself previously selected; no guarantee of a new discovery.
promotion: Research-only unless every saved policy gate, empirical family-null, neighborhood, native equity-path and measured extra-cost requirement passes. Never deploy or change live portfolios in this study.
